title: Sizing & clearspace
slide_intent: Give a logo enough space to read at its smallest intended size. A measure derived from the mark travels with it when the artwork is scaled.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can protect both versions of its signature while setting separate thresholds for their different proportions.
demonstration: Symbol silhouettes indicate clearspace around the primary and secondary lockups. Smaller specimens give each logo its own minimum width for print and screen.
practical_value: Use the symbol width as the minimum surrounding clearance. Check the relevant minimum size: 25 mm or 110 px for the primary, 15 mm or 65 px for the secondary.
